title: ID0471710-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / P1 170000220] Meter State Unavailable
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Meter State Unavailable
Workaround: Restart EcoG and reboot docker
Solution: Update to v9

additional_info.subject: ID0471710-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / P1 170000220] Meter State Unavailable CRM:03289000210
additional_info.body:
Hi Konrad, good afternoon.
Sorry for the delay.
This is the problem that we facing with the EcoG which is fixed in v9.
Unfortunately, there is no easier way than rebooting the EcoG and restarting the docker but since you have limited SSH access, if restarting the EcoG is not enough, then a full reboot will do it.
If, after performing a reboot, it's still not working and there seems to be no reason, please reach out to me and i can fix it quick.
I will proceed to close the ticket since the problem is resolved.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
